headline: Sr. Software Engineer | Fullstack Product & Growth

bullets.text: Raised 7-day activation 7% and doubled feature adoption as the founding member of SchoolAI's growth engineering team, hiring teammates and building strategy.
Built a real-time AI analysis layer over 17k+ daily student chats that gives teachers insights, sentiment, progress scoring, and alerts for concerning content.
Kept streaming AI chat fast and responsive, cutting re-renders over 85% by restructuring state ownership and narrowing Zustand store subscriptions.
Gave AI chats context over time by architecting RAG-based memory that embeds memories extracted from conversations and retrieves the most relevant through vector search.
Led the evolution of SchoolAI's onboarding from a static landing page into a multi-step profile flow, AI-generated next steps, and personalized guided tours, so new users reach value faster.
Drove UX decisions with onboarding A/B tests and funnel analytics.
Drive server-side rendering in SchoolAI's Next.js app, including an SSR-safe client-storage package for session storage and cookies and localization in server components.
Prototype new features alongside designers and set them up to prototype on their own with real design-system components, so ideas get tested before they're built.
Serve as team lead, mentoring engineers through 1:1s, code review, and hands-on onboarding.
Drove a company-critical accessibility initiative across 6 teams, closing 480 WCAG 2.1 issues and delivering SchoolAI's first VPAT, which unlocked major higher-ed and statewide deals.
Developed the React frontend for Lucid's integration marketplace, driving 14 new partner-built integrations and 540,000+ installs in its first year.
Kept Lucid's high-traffic marketing sites fast by optimizing caching and static generation.
Built React and TypeScript components for Lucid's design system, so teams didn't rebuild common UI.
Led a team of engineers, mentoring through regular 1:1s, targeted feedback, and code review.
Rebuilt canyonsdistrict.org from scratch, cutting average page load times 20%.
Architected a permissions allocation system with site-wide activity auditing and improved LDAP authentication, strengthening security and operational visibility.

body: The best product engineers I know pair strong product sense with a real obsession over the details, go wherever in the stack the problem lives, and can point to the metrics that prove their work mattered. That's the bar I've tried to hold myself to at SchoolAI.

My favorite example is the real-time analysis layer I led for our student chats. Teachers can't read every conversation, but they still need to know which students are stuck, which are thriving, and which need a person right away. So we analyze conversations as they happen, now more than 17,000 chats a day, and turn them into insights, sentiment, progress scores, and alerts for concerning content that teachers can act on. Getting it right meant caring as much about the alert a teacher reads as about the pipeline behind it.

On the metrics side, I was the founding member of our growth engineering team. We shipped onboarding across the stack in small, measured steps, and the experiments regularly told me my favorite version wasn't the best one. Together, the team raised 7-day activation 7% and doubled feature adoption.

Discord's Engagement team works where all of that matters most, in the messaging, voice, profiles, and navigation people use every day. I'd love to help make the conversations at the heart of Discord feel even better.
coverLetter.signoff: Thank you for your time & consideration,
